historical_record.description: The Recreation and Park Commission named the mini park at O'Farrell and Larkin Streets in honor of Sgt. John Macaulay.

Officer John S. Macaulay Park, the mini park at the northeast corner of Larkin and O'Farrell Streets bought and developed under the Open Space Program, was to be dedicated on February 22, 1983, with Mayor Dianne Feinstein and Police Chief Con Murphy; the general manager reported it well designed and well lighted.
